videos.name: Streets of Fire
videos.overview: In the wake of the volcanic eruption, Maddie and the 118 race to divert a river of lava before it consumes a packed hospital. Athena, still trapped underground, faces a massive obstacle that cuts her off from any chance of calling for help.
